links.outcome: Association between radiologist AI use and burnout (emotional exhaustion or depersonalization)
links.effect: AI use associated with increased odds of burnout (OR 1.20; 95% CI 1.10-1.30), driven by emotional exhaustion (OR 1.21). Weighted burnout prevalence 40.9% vs 38.6%. Stronger with high workload and lower AI acceptance.
links.quote: After adjusting for covariates, AI use was significantly associated with increased odds of burnout (odds ratio [OR], 1.20; 95% CI, 1.10-1.30), primarily driven by its association with EE (OR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.10-1.34).

screen.reason: This is an empirical survey of radiologists in real deployment environments assessing the relationship between regular AI use, workload, acceptance, and radiologist burnout. It observes associations with AI use rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or practice.
